description.value:
The creative half of a artifex is the signature style of their expression, known as their motif. Luminaries might create magic with vivid imagery that evokes life’s vibrancy, or evocative concepts that strike deep thoughts. This style could be something they were inspired by or taught by a artifex they studied under – but it serves as a artifex’s vision and message. As a budding artifex, you select one artifex’s motif at 1st level to represent the foundation of your motif that you would build upon, creating a style that is uniquely yours.

Selecting a artifex’s motif determines your favored tradition of magic, a visionary spell, additional spells that are added into your portfolio, and bonus motif spell slots that can be used to cast spells of the motif’s favored tradition. Spells you gain from the motif are always of its favored tradition. The list of motifs are:

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.Wus5fKeKOqnAxd9g]{Negative Space}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.Y3Uc1ahKffDkGzUG]{Sharp Shading}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.SE5Y5lHiYrf5Tptb]{Quasi-Realism}

  • @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.q3zFnfVW5mxT9Z9Z]{Abstract Fractals}
